sentences.en: Could you give me a lift to the train station?
sentences.zh: 你能顺便送我去火车站吗？

sentences.en: I forgot to lift the receiver before dialing the number.
sentences.zh: 我拨号之前忘了拿起听筒。

sentences.en: The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
sentences.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我拿不起来。

senses.zh: 举起；提升；空运；鼓舞；[口]抄袭
